title: Rendering through a shared protocol
description: You can inspect the methods used by a collection of unrelated shape classes.

steps.description: Drawable declares draw and area methods. The decorator permits the runtime isinstance checks used later.
Circle, Square and Triangle each implement both methods. You can also see a separate class with only draw.

steps.question: Which two methods will render_all call for each supplied shape?
steps.answer: It calls draw for a description and area for a number formatted to four decimal places.

steps.description: You see three descriptions and areas printed. The later checks report True for Circle and Square, and False for the three remaining tested objects.
The printed method resolution orders list Circle and object, or Square and object. You can inspect those inheritance chains alongside the successful protocol checks.
